propositions: Twelve transport members the reconciler core invokes are absent from JiraDataCenterTransport and declared on no Protocol, so a writing reconcile pass cannot complete.

The dominant failure mode is silent degradation, not crashing: seven members are swallowed at every call site and three are mixed, so a DC deployment appears to converge while not syncing comments, links, parents, or properties.

Each of the twelve members requires a per-method triage verdict (IMPLEMENT via DC REST v2 / NotImplementedError / unreachable), not a blanket Cloud-copy, because get_parent_map, set_reporter, and set_parent each break the naive rule.

set_reporter must be implemented with a DC name payload AND inbound_fields._identity_of must carry DC's name into account_id, otherwise the reporter mutation re-emits every pass and idempotence fails.
TicketTransport must be made @runtime_checkable and conformance asserted in the backend factories so a missing member fails loudly at construction rather than mid-pass.

A structural audit test must collect every attribute access on a client/transport receiver so an undeclared transport member cannot be introduced silently, and each newly-implemented member must log an observable warning naming the member and remote id.
